notes: Additional Defense: a second defense each round at extraPenalty (it replaces the old second-parry penalty, so parry.repeatPenalty is 0). Core attack and defense rules, published for every Legend Dynamics setting. A pack's combatRules can add rules or override parameters (Trails of Blood & Dust: bare-handed parries against claws). The same ids are the Rules Lab's experiments.

protection.name: Improvised shield
protection.text: Anything that can stand in for a shield, snatched up in the fight: you Block with it at no bonus. It breaks the first time it blocks a hit of 2 or more boxes.
